name: vault
description: Keep step notes and handoffs in an Obsidian vault so you can clear long chats at 200-300k tokens and resume without losing the thread. Cuts cache-read tokens, so the same usage limit goes roughly twice as far.

vault_path.title: Vault folder
vault_path.description: Folder for the Obsidian vault. It doesn't have to exist yet: /vault:setup creates it or adopts an existing folder. ~ means your home folder. Example on Windows: C:\Users\you\Documents\Claude Vault

python.title: Python 3 command
python.description: Command or full path that runs Python 3.8 or later. Usually python on Windows and python3 on macOS and Linux. A full path to python.exe works too.

inject_rules.title: Load the note rules every session
inject_rules.description: Adds the short note-keeping rules (about 500 tokens) to every session through the SessionStart hook. Turn off only if you pasted rules/vault-rules.md into your own CLAUDE.md instead.
